description: CR 509.1b Questing Beast can't be blocked by a creature with power 2 or less
note: Questing Beast can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less, a card-authored restriction. The 2/1 Goblin Piker is not asked to block (an unscheduled block prompt would fail the run); the 3/3 War Mammoth's twin case stands.
